html:
10 Mountain Passes That Attract Backpackers, let’s take a look to have a trip to conquer and admire the scenery of the mountain pass and hunt for clouds, immersing yourself in the sea of ​​clouds.

With Vietlook, experience the winding, dangerous pass, with the majestic beauty of the Northwest route, visitors will admire the scenery with the clouds floating on the mountainside, the most beautiful is in the early morning, visitors stand from above looking down at the valley covered in fog, or next to the corn fields, terraced fields covered in fog.

The first destination that backpackers hunt for is Fansipan

A place with a cool climate all year round, is one of the indispensable destinations in the Sapa travel itinerary, to conquer the roof of Indochina, visitors will experience the cable car route, and admire the scenery floating in the mist of the Northwest mountains and forests.

Phu Si Lung

A place with wild beauty, to reach the top of the mountain you must ask for permission from Pa Ve Su border post, located in Muong Te district, to get here, backpackers must conquer from Sin Chai A village.

Pu Ta Leng

Belonging to Hoang Lien Son range, a place with its own beauty, a pristine beauty with blooming rhododendron flowers, a beautiful flower of the Northwest mountains and forests.

Ky Quan San

The mountain is the border between Lao Cai and Lai Chau, visitors can conquer this mountain peak in Bat Xat, or from Den Sung village, Sin Sui Ho commune, Phong Tho district, Lai Chau province.

Phan Lien San

Located on the Vietnam – China border, Phan Lien San belongs to Phong Tho – Lai Chau, between marker 79 and marker 80, is the location of marker 79 – the highest border marker in Vietnam, at an altitude of 2,880m, a destination sought after by many backpackers.

Ta Lien (2,987m)

If you are a trekking lover, Ta Lien is the destination for you, Ta Lien peak is the border between Lai Chau and Lao Cai provinces, a virtual living spot that many tourists visit, especially at the end of the year when tourists come to hunt clouds.

Phu Luong Mountain (Yen Bai 2,985m)

To conquer this beautiful destination, visitors should start from Tram Tau, and cross the winding roads with many dangers, however, when conquering Pu Luong peak, visitors will be immersed in the sea of ​​clouds, visitors can save for themselves beautiful pictures next to the floating clouds.

Bach Moc Luong Lai Chau (2,967m)

It is the natural border between the Vietnam – China border, and is located between landmark 83, from here visitors can admire the beauty of the Hoang Lien Son mountain range, a beautiful and peaceful natural scene.

Coming here, visitors will be immersed in the beautiful nature, fresh climate, with the gentle and hospitable people, visitors should conquer the pass with the local people through the primeval forests with majestic scenery that will bring visitors the most unforgettable memories.

Nhiu Co San 2,950m

Located in Sang Ma Sao, Bat Xat district, Lao Cai, according to locals, this is the father Nhiu Co San, and the mother Nhiu Co San is Lao Than peak (2,860m high) in Phin Ho village, Y Ty commune, a cloud hunting spot sought after by many backpackers.

Chung Nghia Vu 2,918m

Located in Nam Khe area, Phong Tho district, Lai Chau, this is the natural boundary on the Vietnam – China border and near landmarks 83, 84, to get here you can go to Sapa, Y Ty, and to Nam Xe.

As one of the short mountain passes, the road here is very convenient, to get here you have to cross the bamboo forest, or the clear streams, you can sit right on the slab to admire the scenery in the middle of nature, and cross the cardamom forest to reach Chung Nghia Vu.
